vc_checking.summary: All seven current manual witnesses are semantically proofable. The entailment splits the dispatch anchor into member and sentinel cases, then uses first-occurrence or last-node DLL decomposition. The four return witnesses rebuild the circular list after the four pointer stores. The member derivation chooses the public member state unchanged; the sentinel derivation chooses the sentinel state unchanged and rewrites insert-before-at-an-absent-sentinel to append. Two pure list helpers are likely useful; all spatial decomposition and freshness facts can be proved locally from xizi_dll/xizi_dllseg and separated stores.

vc_shape.pre_spatial: The local linklist variable stores linklist_pre, together with xizi_dll head_dispatch_case nodes_dispatch_case and a disjoint standalone xizi_dll_node linklist_node_pre.
vc_shape.pre_pure: xizi_double_link_insert_before_anchor head_dispatch_case nodes_dispatch_case linklist_pre, i.e. membership or equality with the sentinel.
vc_shape.pre_exists: The witnesses hidden in xizi_dll are its first/last links and recursive dllseg chain.
vc_shape.post_spatial: One of four implementation Assert branches: member-at-first, member-after-a nonempty prefix, sentinel with nonempty nodes, or sentinel with empty nodes, retaining the local-variable store and standalone node.
vc_shape.post_pure: The selected branch records the appropriate list decomposition, first-occurrence condition, insert_before_nodes equation, non-null guards, and predecessor/last equalities.
vc_shape.post_exists: Instantiate first, last, next, prev, before_prev, nodes_before/nodes_after and optionally prefix0 from the DLL split.

witnesses.witness_instantiation: Unfold anchor. In the member branch, choose the first occurrence decomposition nodes_before ++ linklist_pre :: nodes_after; reverse-split nodes_before into nil or prefix0 ++ [prev]. In the sentinel branch, set linklist_pre=head and reverse-split nodes into nil or prefix0 ++ [prev]. DLL unfolding supplies first/last/next/before_prev.
witnesses.space_plan: Open xizi_dll. For membership, inductively focus xizi_dllseg at the first anchor and expose its predecessor link, anchor link and suffix segment; for an empty prefix the predecessor is the sentinel, otherwise preserve a prefix segment ending at prev. For the sentinel case, use the empty DLL form or expose the final node of a nonempty segment. Derive freshness inequalities for the standalone node from disjoint ownership of its two fields and the corresponding sentinel/member link stores.
witnesses.pure_plan: The member first-occurrence decomposition gives ~In linklist_pre nodes_before, then the first-occurrence list helper computes insert_before_nodes. For linklist_pre=head, recursive dllseg guards imply ~In head nodes_dispatch_case; the absent-anchor list helper computes append(nodes,[linklist_node_pre]). All non-null and unequal-to-sentinel facts come from xizi_dll/xizi_dllseg guards and separated field ownership.
witnesses.refinement_plan: No safeExec or refinement state occurs; this is direct separation-logic decomposition.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: First add and prove the two group-suffixed pure list helpers by induction. Prove entail_wit_1 by unfolding anchor, recursing over xizi_dll/xizi_dllseg to focus the first member or last sentinel predecessor, and deriving freshness from separated stores. Prove return_wit_1 through return_wit_4 by selecting their full-DLL disjuncts, normalizing the supplied list equalities, locally folding the updated link stores into one/two dllseg layers, appending unchanged segments, and closing xizi_dll. Prove sentinel contract derivation with existential head=linklist_pre and nodes=nodes_sentinel_case, derive sentinel absence from dllseg guards, rewrite with the absent helper, and construct the identity wand. Prove member derivation with existential head=head_member_case and nodes=nodes_member_case; the output assertions are then identical.
proof_groups.natural_language_proof_strategy: The C implementation performs one mathematical operation: splice a fresh node before a member, or append it when the anchor is the sentinel. Keep the proof at this list-and-DLL level. The implementation Assert exposes exactly the predecessor/suffix cuts needed by the four returns, while the two public-contract witnesses are identity-wand inclusions after choosing dispatch parameters and normalizing the list function.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: One function, one list transform, one DLL predicate family, shared pure helpers, no inter-group dependency, and seven witnesses within the controller limit of 12. A single worker can reuse local segment focus/append and freshness arguments without cross-group helper duplication.
